title: Remember the Five Phases

breakdown.detail: Define targets, objectives, and constraints before any technical work begins. Signed scope document + RoE.
Build a complete picture of the target through passive OSINT and authorised active recon. Output: target profile.
Port scan, service detect, vulnerability scan, enumerate. Output: structured vulnerability list.
Confirm vulnerabilities are genuinely exploitable. Document every step with evidence. Output: exploitation notes.
Deliver a professional report: executive summary, detailed findings, CVSS ratings, and remediation guidance. Output: the deliverable the client paid for.

additionalNote: The two 'S' words — Skilled (Scoping) and Systematically (Scanning) — remind you that this work requires precision at both ends: the beginning (defining what you're doing) and the middle (doing it systematically). The two 'R' words — Researchers (Recon) and Responsibly (Reporting) — bracket the technical phases. Research without responsible documentation is incomplete work.
